# Enterprise Knowledge Copilot

> A knowledge copilot over company documents. Answers carry citations to the
> passage they came from, refuse when the documents do not cover the question,
> and only retrieve documents the signed-in role may read.

## What it is

- Live product: https://enterprise-knowledge-copilot-wine.vercel.app
- Sample workspace: “Open sample workspace” on the home page signs a visitor in
  as a read-only guest, with no account.
- API health: https://enterprise-knowledge-copilot-2u57.onrender.com/health

## How it works

1. The question and the caller's role are sent to the API with a bearer token.
2. Hybrid retrieval runs inside Postgres: pgvector similarity plus full-text,
   fused with reciprocal rank fusion. The role and department predicate is part
   of the SQL, so a document outside the caller's permissions is never selected.
3. An ONNX cross-encoder ranks the candidates.
4. One grounded model call returns whether the passages answer the question, the
   answer, and the passage numbers it used.
5. Citations are checked against the retrieved passages. A refusal carries the
   closest documents and is queued for an administrator as an unanswered question.

## Access model

- guest: public
- employee: public + employee
- engineering / security / hr / finance: public + employee + own department
- admin: everything, including the confidential set

## Pages

- / — product overview and the sample workspace
- /product — walkthrough
- /security — practical controls
- /privacy, /terms — what is stored and the terms of use
- /contact — email
- /licenses — corpus attribution and model licences
- /login — email and password sign-in
- /chat, /library — the workspace
- /admin, /admin/quality — administrators only
